name: Neon Drift
author: ToiletCat Games
description:
Neon Drift is an arcade racing game for PlayStation Vita focused on drifting mechanics and time-based gameplay. Players control a vehicle through neon-themed environments while aiming to maintain speed and complete runs as efficiently as possible.
The game features stylized visuals inspired by neon aesthetics, score-based progression, and driving challenges centered around precision and vehicle control. Neon Drift is developed by ToiletCat Games for the PlayStation Vita platform.
